description: Header file defining the Win32Window class, which provides an abstraction for a high DPI-aware Win32 window, including methods for creation, display, destruction, and message handling.

classes.name: Win32Window
classes.description: A class abstraction for a high DPI-aware Win32 Window, intended for inheritance to customize rendering and input handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a Win32 window with specified title, origin, and size.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Releases OS resources associated with the window.

methods.name: SetChildContent
methods.description: Sets the child content HWND within the window.

methods.name: SetQuitOnClose
methods.description: Sets whether closing the window quits the application.

methods.name: GetClientArea
methods.description: Returns the RECT of the client area.

methods.name: MessageHandler
methods.description: Handles window messages, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: OnCreate
methods.description: Called during window creation, can be overridden.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Called during window destruction, can be overridden.
